description: KIP v1.2 expanded retrieval evaluation benchmark: 80 labelled cases across 6 challenge categories (exact terminology, paraphrase, multi-concept, hard negative disambiguation, cross-document, and boundary handling) evaluated against a 50-document reference corpus (corpus_v1_2_expanded). Designed to provide discriminative retrieval ranking evaluation without top-3/top-5 saturation.

cases.question: What HTTP header must accompany every workspace-scoped API request in KIP?
cases.reference_answer: Every workspace-scoped request must supply the X-KIP-Workspace-ID header.

cases.question: What is the maximum upload file size in bytes supported by KIP document parsers?
cases.reference_answer: The maximum upload size limit is 2097152 bytes (2 MB).

cases.question: What are the default character chunk size and overlap values in KIP?
cases.reference_answer: The default chunk size is 1000 characters with 200 characters of overlap.

cases.question: What is the effective step size in characters between consecutive chunk starts?
cases.reference_answer: The effective step size is 800 characters between chunk start positions.

cases.question: What is the default Qdrant vector store collection name used by KIP?
cases.reference_answer: KIP uses a default Qdrant collection named knowledge_base.

cases.question: How many dimensions does the production Gemini embedding model generate in KIP?
cases.reference_answer: The gemini-embedding-2 model produces 768-dimensional dense vectors.

cases.question: What language model drives generative responses in KIP production deployments?
cases.reference_answer: The production generative model is Gemini 2.5 Flash via GeminiLLMProvider.

cases.question: What endpoint serves the system health check in the FastAPI backend?
cases.reference_answer: The health check endpoint is exposed at GET /api/v1/health.

cases.question: What is the maximum number of documents permitted in a single workspace?
cases.reference_answer: A single workspace may index a maximum of 50 documents (MAX_DOCUMENTS_PER_WORKSPACE=50).

cases.question: What is the ceiling on total vector chunks allowed in a single workspace?
cases.reference_answer: A workspace can store up to 1000 chunks (MAX_CHUNKS_PER_WORKSPACE=1000).

cases.question: What is the word limit enforced on user feedback messages?
cases.reference_answer: Feedback messages are strictly limited to a maximum of 30 words.

cases.question: What Google Apps Script HTTP handler function receives KIP feedback submissions?
cases.reference_answer: The Google Apps Script web app implements doGet(e) to receive HTTPS GET requests.

cases.question: How is Qdrant cosine distance converted to a similarity score in KIP?
cases.reference_answer: Qdrant converts cosine distance to a similarity score using: score = 1 - distance.

cases.question: What base class from Pydantic manages centralized application settings in KIP?
cases.reference_answer: KIP uses Pydantic BaseSettings in app.core.config.

cases.question: What is the default temperature setting passed to LLM generation in KIP?
cases.reference_answer: Temperature defaults to 0.0 to ensure deterministic, reproducible generation.

cases.question: What prefix is prepended to cryptographically random workspace access tokens?
cases.reference_answer: Workspace tokens use the wksp_ prefix and have at least 256 bits of entropy.

cases.question: Which file types can organizations feed into their private enterprise knowledge vaults?
cases.reference_answer: KIP supports PDF, DOCX, TXT, and Markdown files.

cases.question: How does the platform ensure that repeatedly re-indexing a text file never duplicates data?
cases.reference_answer: Document IDs are derived from SHA-256 of file bytes, enabling idempotent upserts.

cases.question: Why does the system refuse to answer inquiries when no relevant background context exists?
cases.reference_answer: The empty context guard short-circuits generation to eliminate hallucinations and save API costs.

cases.question: In what way does the chat interface let people verify where factual statements came from?
cases.reference_answer: Expandable provenance cards display excerpt text, document name, chunk index, and similarity scores.

cases.question: How does the cloud service gracefully wake up sleeping containers on free hosting tiers?
cases.reference_answer: The Streamlit frontend pings the health check with exponential retry backoff while displaying a wake-up banner.

cases.question: What prevents one enterprise tenant from reading another organization's confidential embeddings?
cases.reference_answer: Mandatory workspace_id payload filtering in Qdrant isolates tenant vectors at the database tier.

cases.question: How does the software handle Word document tables so that column data remains understandable?
cases.reference_answer: Table cells are joined with pipe delimiters to preserve column layout relationships.

cases.question: What mechanism guarantees that evaluating retrieval improvements will never touch customer workspaces?
cases.reference_answer: EvaluationRunner explicitly injects a dedicated evaluation workspace ID such as kip-eval-workspace.

cases.question: How does the system ensure evaluation tests produce identical results across Windows and Linux machines?
cases.reference_answer: Corpus files strictly use Unix LF line endings to ensure deterministic SHA-256 hash calculation.

cases.question: What fallback vector database adapter allows developer testing without external cloud network calls?
cases.reference_answer: ChromaVectorStoreProvider initializes an ephemeral in-memory Chroma client for offline testing.

cases.question: Why does the Gemini embedding provider omit the task type parameter when generating embeddings?
cases.reference_answer: Google Gemini documentation states task_type is unsupported for gemini-embedding-2.

cases.question: How does the user interface prevent session data from leaking when a person switches tenants?
cases.reference_answer: Switching workspaces clears the chat history and cached document lists in Streamlit session state.

cases.question: What prevents random web crawlers from injecting malicious feedback rows into Google Sheets?
cases.reference_answer: A shared secret token passed as a query parameter is authenticated by the Apps Script handler.

cases.question: How does the RAG prompt instruct the language model to handle inquiries it cannot verify?
cases.reference_answer: System instructions mandate that the model refuse to answer if facts are not in context.

cases.question: What happens when an uploaded PDF file contains password encryption?
cases.reference_answer: PyPDF catches PdfReadError and raises an IngestionError immediately.

cases.question: How does the platform handle unexpected server crashes to avoid exposing internal tracebacks?
cases.reference_answer: Centralized FastAPI exception handlers return standardized RFC 7807 error responses.

cases.question: How do workspace IDs propagate from HTTP request headers into Qdrant vector search filters?
cases.reference_answer: FastAPI extracts X-KIP-Workspace-ID, which RetrievalService attaches to Qdrant payload filters.

cases.question: How does DocumentIngestionService connect file byte hashing with chunk identifier generation?
cases.reference_answer: Document ID is SHA-256(raw_bytes); chunk ID is SHA-256(doc_id + ':' + chunk_index).

cases.question: How does the PDF parser attach page metadata that downstream provenance models expose to users?
cases.reference_answer: PyPDF annotates each page string with page_number, which Chunk metadata propagates to source cards.

cases.question: How do workspace capacity limits interact with Qdrant Cloud cluster memory protections?
cases.reference_answer: Limits of 50 docs and 1000 chunks prevent free-tier cluster memory and API quota exhaustion.

cases.question: How does EmbeddingManager isolate upper retrieval services from specific third-party embedding SDKs?
cases.reference_answer: EmbeddingManager uses a provider registry to route embed requests to Gemini or OpenAI adapters.

cases.question: How does QdrantVectorStoreProvider map cosine distance metrics into similarity scores?
cases.reference_answer: Cosine distance returned by Qdrant is transformed via score = 1 - distance, bounded [0, 1].

cases.question: How does RAGService coordinate query vectorization, prompt formatting, and generative LLM completion?
cases.reference_answer: RAGService queries RetrievalService, formats source XML blocks, and calls LLMService.

cases.question: How do feedback modal submissions in Streamlit securely route through FastAPI to Google Sheets?
cases.reference_answer: Streamlit posts to FastAPI, which validates the payload and issues an authenticated HTTPS GET to Apps Script.

cases.question: How does EvaluationRunner maintain test isolation while measuring retrieval latency and MRR?
cases.reference_answer: EvaluationRunner uses config.evaluation_workspace_id and times the retrieval phase in milliseconds.

cases.question: How does KIP calculate Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) across labelled evaluation cases?
cases.reference_answer: MRR averages 1/rank of the first relevant hit across cases with populated expected IDs.

cases.question: How does the paired experiment protocol compare Control and Treatment conditions without data contamination?
cases.reference_answer: Both conditions evaluate identical queries over identical corpora indexed into separate Qdrant collections.

cases.question: How does the Streamlit UI layout connect file uploads with backend parsing status spinners?
cases.reference_answer: Document Manager renders drag-and-drop file inputs and displays a spinner while indexing.

cases.question: How does Pydantic BaseSettings handle fallback defaults when environment variables are omitted?
cases.reference_answer: BaseSettings loads environment variables and falls back to defined class attributes.

cases.question: How does the Dockerfile configure the non-root execution environment for Render hosting?
cases.reference_answer: The Dockerfile uses python:3.11-slim, installs dependencies, and runs Uvicorn on port 8000.

cases.question: How does the security model ensure workspace bearer tokens cannot be guessed by adversaries?
cases.reference_answer: Tokens are generated with python secrets module providing at least 256 bits of cryptographic entropy.

cases.question: How does the DOCX parser handle paragraph extraction without writing temporary files to disk?
cases.reference_answer: The parser loads raw byte streams directly into docx.Document in memory.

cases.question: What document chunking strategy does KIP actively implement in its production ingestion service?
cases.reference_answer: KIP implements fixed-size character chunking with sliding window overlap (1000/200), not semantic or recursive splitting.

cases.question: What vector store engine powers multi-tenant cloud retrieval in active KIP deployments?
cases.reference_answer: KIP uses Qdrant Cloud with workspace payload filters, not local Chroma DuckDB files.

cases.question: Does KIP currently utilize sparse lexical search like BM25 or SPLADE in its retrieval pipeline?
cases.reference_answer: No, KIP uses dense vector search only; hybrid BM25 and SPLADE search are proposed research candidates.

cases.question: How are benchmark evaluations conducted in KIP: through external LLM judges or mechanical metrics?
cases.reference_answer: KIP uses deterministic mechanical metrics (Hit Rate, MRR, keyword coverage) in runner.py, not external LLM judges like Ragas.

cases.question: What caching technology is deployed in KIP v1.1 to cache embedding vectors and LLM answers?
cases.reference_answer: KIP v1.1 has no Redis semantic cache; caching is deferred to v1.3 performance engineering.

cases.question: Does KIP v1.1 support multi-turn conversational dialogue memory across successive user questions?
cases.reference_answer: No, KIP operates in single-turn question-answering mode; conversational memory is deferred to v2.0.

cases.question: What autonomous multi-step reasoning framework like LangGraph or CrewAI powers KIP workflows?
cases.reference_answer: KIP does not use autonomous agentic frameworks; it is a direct single-step RAG platform.

cases.question: Does KIP store knowledge relationships in a Neo4j property graph database for GraphRAG?
cases.reference_answer: No, KIP relies strictly on dense vector search in Qdrant; Neo4j graph integration is deferred to v2.4.

cases.question: How is the KIP production backend hosted: on a Kubernetes cluster or Render Free Tier?
cases.reference_answer: KIP is deployed as a single container on Render Free Tier, not on a distributed Kubernetes cluster.

cases.question: What authentication standard protects KIP tenant workspaces: OAuth2/OIDC SSO or bearer tokens?
cases.reference_answer: KIP uses lightweight cryptographically random bearer tokens (wksp_...), not enterprise OAuth2/OIDC SSO.

cases.question: How are language model tokens transmitted to the UI: via streaming WebSockets or synchronous JSON?
cases.reference_answer: KIP processes RAG queries synchronously returning a complete response entity, not streaming WebSockets/SSE.

cases.question: Does the active KIP retrieval pipeline include a second-stage cross-encoder reranker like Cohere Rerank?
cases.reference_answer: No, KIP performs single-stage retrieval directly from Qdrant; cross-encoder reranking is a research candidate.

cases.question: Where does ChromaVectorStoreProvider store vector files during automated pytest execution?
cases.reference_answer: It stores vectors in memory (persist_directory=None), not in legacy disk paths like data/chroma.

cases.question: How does KIP prevent hallucinations: by prompting strict grounding or through post-generation Ragas checks?
cases.reference_answer: KIP enforces strict grounding prompt instructions in RAGService, not post-generation LLM-as-judge scoring.

cases.question: How does the Streamlit UI handle dormant backend containers on Render without caching answers in Redis?
cases.reference_answer: The UI polls the health endpoint with exponential retry backoff and displays a wake-up banner.

cases.question: What entity coordinates vector transformations without introducing LangChain or LlamaIndex dependencies?
cases.reference_answer: EmbeddingManager coordinates vector transformations through internal provider classes without framework overhead.

cases.question: How do document parser upload limits and workspace chunk capacities work together to bound tenant resource usage?
cases.reference_answer: Parser limits restrict individual files to 2 MB, while workspace bounds enforce maximums of 50 documents and 1000 chunks.

cases.question: How do PDF and DOCX parsers extract structured textual information from complex business files?
cases.reference_answer: PyPDF extracts text page by page with page_number metadata, while python-docx extracts paragraphs and pipe-delimited tables.

cases.question: How does the content-addressed hashing algorithm establish deterministic document and chunk IDs?
cases.reference_answer: Document ID is SHA-256 of raw file bytes; chunk ID is SHA-256 of document_id and chunk_index.

cases.question: What embedding providers are supported in KIP and what output dimensionalities do they produce?
cases.reference_answer: GeminiEmbeddingProvider produces 768-dimensional vectors; OpenAIEmbeddingProvider produces 1536-dimensional vectors.

cases.question: How do Qdrant Cloud and embedded Chroma vector store implementations enforce workspace tenant filtering?
cases.reference_answer: Qdrant applies payload FieldCondition on workspace_id; Chroma applies where={'workspace_id': workspace_id}.

cases.question: What language model providers can power answer generation and what models do they target?
cases.reference_answer: GeminiLLMProvider targets gemini-2.5-flash; OpenAILLMProvider targets gpt-4o-mini.

cases.question: How does user feedback travel from the Streamlit UI to Google Sheets with token authentication?
cases.reference_answer: Streamlit sends feedback to FastAPI, which dispatches an HTTPS GET request to Google Apps Script with secret token verification.

cases.question: How do EvaluationRunner and Pydantic benchmark schemas measure Hit Rate and Mean Reciprocal Rank?
cases.reference_answer: EvaluationRunner runs cases against retrieval, populating RetrievalMetrics and aggregating Hit Rate and MRR in BenchmarkResult.

cases.question: What error is raised when a client issues a vector retrieval search without providing a workspace ID?
cases.reference_answer: RetrievalService raises a RetrievalError stating that workspace_id is required.

cases.question: How does the platform prevent denial-of-service through oversized document uploads?
cases.reference_answer: Document parsers reject any file whose size exceeds the MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE_BYTES limit (2097152 bytes).

cases.question: What happens when a search query returns zero matching vectors or all scores fall below threshold?
cases.reference_answer: RAGService short-circuits and returns a predefined message without calling the generation LLM.

cases.question: What HTTP status code is returned when user feedback is submitted with an unconfigured webhook destination?
cases.reference_answer: FastAPI returns HTTP 503 with error code feedback_destination_unconfigured.

cases.question: How does the evaluation runner distinguish an infrastructure outage from a genuine retrieval miss?
cases.reference_answer: Infrastructure failures are recorded in RetrievalMetrics.retrieval_error, leaving misses with error None.

cases.question: What happens if an unlabelled benchmark case with empty expected document IDs is evaluated?
cases.reference_answer: The case is marked as unlabelled and excluded from aggregate Hit Rate and MRR calculations.

cases.question: How does KIP protect database connection secrets when unexpected internal errors occur?
cases.reference_answer: Exception handlers sanitize error details and return RFC 7807 responses without exposing tracebacks or credentials.

cases.question: What prevents benchmark ground truth IDs from breaking when running tests on Windows systems?
cases.reference_answer: All corpus fixtures are verified to use Unix LF line endings, preventing CRLF hash drift.
